title: Orca's own error message is shown after 'orca terminal create failed:'; no launch folder is left behind
source: cli/jitso/orca.test.ts: 'an ok:false answer throws an OrcaError that carries the code'
intended: owner decision 2026-11-15: a failed launch leaves no launch folder
intent: INTENDED behavior (owner decision 2026-11-15, defect N-2). A launch that fails before its registry line leaves no launch folder behind: the implementation removes .jitso/launches/<id>/ when the launch fails. The exit code, the stderr text, the empty registry and the orca calls are unchanged.
